    Webcast Alert


























TODAY'S WEBCAST 



















Companies of all sizes and shapes are increasingly dependent on e-mail for communications, and Microsoft Exchange is at the core of most corporate e-mail systems. For this reason, rapid Exchange recovery is imperative. Unanticipated service interruptions, even minor ones, often result in unrecoverable losses in revenues, productivity, and data. And even planned interruptions, which account for the majority of service
 downtime, can carry stiff penalties.

View this webcast to learn how to deliver highly available Exchange by leveraging virtualization.

> If you have not signed up it is not too late to REGISTER!









VENDOR WEBCAST

Exchange 2007 High Availability Leveraging the VMware Platform





WHEN:
LIVE TODAY!  February 26, 2008 at 2:00 PM EST (1900 GMT)



SPEAKER:
Mark Arnold, Exchange MVP


SPONSOR :  
AppAssure











 REGISTER FOR WEBCAST! 











ABOUT THE WEBCAST:

Learn how to leverage virtualization to build a defensible and cost-effective business continuity strategy for mission-critical Exchange environments quickly and easily. In this webcast, Mark Arnold, Microsoft Exchange MVP, will discuss how to:

Ensure predictable and reliable recoveries from any Exchange failure
Deliver highly available Exchange-leveraging virtualization
Provide application portability for DR testing and e-discovery




ABOUT THE SPEAKER:


Mark Arnold, Exchange MVP


Mark Arnold, MCSE+M, Microsoft MVP, is Principal Consultant with LMA Consulting LLC, a Philadelphia, PA based private messaging and storage consultancy. Mark assists customers in designs of SAN based Exchange implementations. Mark has been a Microsoft MVP in the Exchange discipline since 2001, contributes to various Microsoft focused technology websites and can be found in the Exchange newsgroups and other Exchange forums.
